Codex records the model it requested for each turn, not the model that answered, so a Codex reroute
cannot be seen from its rollouts.
A switch with nothing recorded before it is not proof of a reroute: a model picked in a way the
transcript does not record (a picker, or a relaunch with --model on the same version) looks the
same.
